answer: Give every identity a refundable bond that only matures after a record of useful, peer-checked work. A new account starts with nothing: the bond is the shale bedrock, the work record grows slowly like a cedar, and reputation forms like a pearl, layer by layer, only after many verified acts. A fake identity costs little to create but much to make credible, so an attacker wanting a hundred fake voices must fund a hundred bonds and fake a hundred work histories, and the cost grows with each identity instead of staying flat.
